action_items: Minor code-quality: React hydration warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' from SubDrawer.jsx line ~20 inside MaidAssign <select>. The visual-edit wrapper injects a <span style={{display:'contents'}}> inside each <option>'s children. Browser works but logs a hydration warning. If this component is wrapped by a visual-edit instrumentation that auto-injects spans, consider rendering plain {p.name} without additional children fragments or whitelisting <option> in the instrumentation.
critical_code_review_comments: SubscriptionsAdmin.jsx (221 lines) is well under 700-line budget and cleanly delegates to SubsTable/SubDrawer/SubFilterDrawer — good separation.
sub-copy-{code} buttons use opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 — invisible until row hover; tests must hover first (works correctly).
Drawer loads async; tests should wait for sub-sec-customer rather than sub-detail-drawer to avoid Loading-state false negatives.
Hydration warning (span inside option) noted above — only observable issue.
